title: Second moment of a level polynomial
statement: For nonnegative integers $n$ and $k$, let $L_k$ be the sum, over all $k$-element subsets of $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, of the corresponding sign monomials on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Under the uniform distribution on that cube, $\\mathbb E[L_k(x)^2]=\\binom{n}{k}$.
